constraints.note: stage00/t0001_75-t0003_25 (ev.44/62/81): fingertip contacts the block's side face at table height and the block translates left while the wrist stays behind it — horizontal side contact despite overhead wrist. For non-prehensile pushing, side contact is load-bearing: a top_down press cannot generate the lateral push.

stage00/t0001_00 vs t0004_00: chocolate bar sits well above the push line (block path runs y~260, chocolate at y~185-215); the block never comes close. True that they don't collide, but the obstacle is not on the demonstrated path, so clearance holds trivially and violating-it-fails does not apply. Low votes (3/5, conf 0.32) consistent.

derived/auto item, judged on merits: fine alignment presupposes the block already at the pad; stage00/t0004_00 -> stage01 frames show s1 doing only local rotation/nudges at the pad. Coarse-transport-before-fine is load-bearing ordering.

acceptance.note: holds:at_end contradicted by its own evidence frames (81, 100 = stage00/t0004_00): at s0 end the block's crossbar (long axis) is roughly horizontal in image with stem down, while the pad's crossbar is vertical with stem left (stage00/t0001_00 pad zoom) — residual misorientation ~90 deg, not parallel. Stage s0 ends far from orientational alignment; the rotation is finished in s1.

stage00/t0004_00 (frame 100): block footprint sits on the pad marking, center offset small (~1 block-half-width). As a coarse-tolerance handoff condition it is demonstrated and load-bearing: s1 performs only local corrections at the pad.

constraints.note: stage01/t0006_25, t0006_88 (ev.141/156/172): fingertip nudges the block's right/upper side faces at table height to rotate it stem-down -> stem-left; side contact is required for the fine push corrections.

stage01/t0006_25 -> t0007_50: block rotates ~90 deg during s1 and ends with crossbar vertical-right / stem-left, matching the pad's orientation; at t0007_50 (frame 188) axes parallel. Core goal condition of fine_alignment (also duplicated in acceptance — registry duplication, judged on merits).

stage01/t0006_25 shows pad slivers still peeking out left and lower-right (offset); by t0007_50 and stage02/t0007_50-t0008_71 the marking is fully covered — centers coincide at stage end. Core goal condition.

acceptance.note: frame 188 (stage01/t0007_50): block crossbar vertical-right, stem-left — parallel to pad axes. Necessary for task success (instruction: align with pad).
frame 188 and stage02/t0008_31-t0008_71: pad marking fully covered by block, no gray visible — centers aligned within tolerance. Necessary for success.
